info.prompt: A dramatic Dutch angle shot of the Obsidian Neural Core mid-Frenzy: four players' geometric avatars flicker with stress as their energy bars bleed crimson, the shared ten-by-ten grid alive with cascading emerald and gold tiles while three Wild Blockers pulse rainbow hues—triggering a Wild Scatter—just milliseconds before a Standard Bomb's shockwave rips through granite Stone Blockers, frozen ice crystals shattering in the blast's wake as terminal readouts in the margins scream "ENERGY CRITICAL — FRENZY LOCK"
